# Tests that already fail on an unmodified tree.
#
# `tests/conftest.py` reads this file and marks every id below
# `xfail(strict=True)`, so the tests keep running instead of being deselected:
# an entry that starts passing reports XPASS and, the marker being strict, fails
# the run. That is what forces its line out of the file, so the list cannot
# quietly rot. Nothing here is caused by wiring the suite into CI, and none of
# it is fixed here on purpose: the list reports the gap, it does not paper over
# it.
#
# Two markers change how an entry is treated, and both the step and the hook
# read them so the two agree:
#
#   # windows-only   the step deselects the id on Windows alone, and the hook
#                    leaves it out on Linux, so there it runs and passes —
#                    the only platform where the symlink rejection it covers is
#                    exercised at all.
#   # non-strict     the hook marks the id xfail(strict=False), in CI as well as
#                    locally: it keeps running, but a pass is reported as XPASS
#                    without failing the run. Used for the order-dependent pair,
#                    which passes in isolation and only fails in a single-process
#                    run.
#
# Provenance. Generated on a clean checkout of
#
#   4f4a0031776cb3fa873a77bdbd0148b658254bb2
#
# with the repository's own requirements-ci.txt installed, from the repository
# root, with the LLM API keys removed from the environment and the Hugging
# Face cache forced offline:
#
#   pytest -q tests -m "not integration"        # -> the 49 further down
#   pytest -q tests -m integration \            # -> the 7 integration entries
#     --ignore tests/integrations/google_adk/ \
#     --ignore tests/integrations/open_ontologies/
#   # HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, no OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/GEMINI key
#
# Both runs were Windows 11 / CPython 3.11; CI is ubuntu-latest / CPython 3.11.
# That measurement is not a superset of a Linux run: the entries appended below
# from the suite's first Linux run are failures it could not see, so this list
# is the union of the two runs rather than an upper bound from either. The
# entries marked `# windows-only` are expected to pass on Linux. The rest are
# expected to reproduce.
#
# Format: one pytest node id per line. A line is an id only when it is
# non-empty and its first character is not `#`, so keep comments flush left —
# an indented comment would be read as a node id. A trailing `# windows-only` or
# `# non-strict` marker is stripped before the id is used. The hook matches
# the id the way pytest writes it relative to the repository root, so it takes
# effect on a run started from the root.
#
# Delete a line to re-enable a test. Fixing the defect behind it is what should
# drive that, not convenience.

# --- Windows-only: symlink creation needs a privilege -------------------------
# `OSError: [WinError 1314] 客户端没有所需的特权` — creating the symlink the
# test needs requires Developer Mode or an elevated shell on Windows. On Linux
# it runs, which is where the rejection is actually covered.
tests/semantic_extract/test_cache_backends.py::test_sqlite_rejects_symlinked_db  # windows-only

# --- A MagicMock reaches code that compares or parses it ----------------------
# `TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'MagicMock'`. The
# doubles these tests install no longer satisfy the signatures the production
# code now uses, so the call raising is the production code behaving correctly.
tests/ingest/test_ingestors.py::TestUnifiedIngest::test_ingest_web_dispatch
tests/ingest/test_ingestors.py::TestWebIngestor::test_ingest_url

# --- Local embedding backend unavailable offline ------------------------------
# `128 != 384` and `'fallback' != 'sentence_transformers'`: the real model could
# not be loaded in this environment, so the fallback backend answers instead.
# The generator-config case is the exception: on the Linux runner the model does
# load and the test passes, so it is marked `# windows-only` rather than left to
# a strict xfail that would fail on that pass.
tests/test_embedding_providers.py::TestEmbeddingProviders::test_embedding_generator_config  # windows-only
tests/test_embedding_providers.py::TestEmbeddingProviders::test_sentence_transformers_default
tests/test_model_selection.py::TestModelSelection::test_dynamic_switching
tests/test_model_selection.py::TestModelSelection::test_generator_switching

# --- Order-dependent: these pass in isolation, fail in a full run -------------
# The progress tracker is process-wide state; whichever test enables it first
# decides what the next one observes. They run under a non-strict xfail, so
# whichever way the order falls the run is not failed by it.
tests/test_arrow_exporter.py::TestArrowExporter::test_progress_tracking  # non-strict
tests/vector_store/test_backward_compatibility.py::TestVectorStoreBackwardCompatibility::test_progress_tracking_unchanged  # non-strict

# --- Assertion drift in the test or its expectation ---------------------------
tests/export/test_distance_exporter.py::test_hop_distance_no_warning_when_kg_unavailable
tests/ingest/test_repo_ingestor_security.py::TestIsReservedNAT64Regression::test_nat64_local_prefix_not_blocked  # windows-only
tests/integrations/agno/test_context_store.py::TestAgnoContextStoreUpsertNERAttributes::test_upsert_indexes_entity_label_as_type
tests/integrations/agno/test_context_store.py::TestAgnoContextStoreUpsertNERAttributes::test_upsert_indexes_entity_text_not_repr
tests/semantic_extract/test_cache_backends.py::test_zero_ttl_expires_immediately_on_both_backends  # windows-only
tests/vector_store/test_hybrid_similarity.py::TestHybridSimilarityCalculator::test_pearson_similarity_calculation
tests/vector_store/test_vector_store.py::test_backend_mirroring_and_save

# --- Integration tests outside the two dedicated integration directories ------
# These carry the `integration` marker but live outside tests/integrations/
# google_adk/ and tests/integrations/open_ontologies/, so the step runs them
# with everything else. They need no service and no network: they already fail
# on an unmodified tree for the same local reasons as the groups above — a
# MagicMock double that no longer fits the production signature, an optional
# `sqlalchemy` extra this job does not install, a fallback backend answering
# because the real embedding model is offline, and two expectation drifts in
# the deepdive suite.
#
# `test_06_hybrid_search` used to sit here: it failed because `HybridSearch`
# dropped the `filter=` argument. #1827 fixed that, the test now passes on the
# runner, and its line is gone.
tests/ingest/test_notebook_02.py::TestNotebook02DataIngestion::test_03_web_ingestion
tests/ingest/test_notebook_02.py::TestNotebook02DataIngestion::test_08_database_ingestion
tests/test_all_features.py::TestSemanticaFeatures::test_03_model_switching
tests/test_semantic_extract_deepdive.py::TestSemanticExtractDeepDive::test_ner_extractor_pattern
tests/test_semantic_extract_deepdive_part2.py::TestSemanticExtractDeepDivePart2::test_coreference_resolver_pronouns
tests/test_semantic_extract_deepdive_part2.py::TestSemanticExtractDeepDivePart2::test_event_detector_basic

# Added 2026-10-02 from CI run 36860808592 (job `build`, ubuntu-latest /
# CPython 3.11), when the suite first ran there. The Windows measurement above
# could not see these: they are environment and expectation drift. No file any
# of them lives in is touched by the change that added this step, so nothing
# here is caused by wiring the suite into CI.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- The CLI wraps the paths it reports mid-token -----------------------------
# `test_reports_the_files_it_wrote` looks for the written filename in the
# command's output, but the reporter hard-wraps that output every ~44 columns,
# so a path is split mid-token (`graph_entities.ar\nrow`). The assertion is a
# substring check, so the wrap decides whether it passes.
tests/test_cli_commands.py::TestExportMultiFileFormats::test_reports_the_files_it_wrote[arrow-.arrow]
tests/test_cli_commands.py::TestExportMultiFileFormats::test_reports_the_files_it_wrote[csv-.csv]
tests/test_cli_commands.py::TestExportMultiFileFormats::test_reports_the_files_it_wrote[parquet-.parquet]

# --- faiss PQ training hits a SIMD constraint in this environment -------------
# `'ksub % 8 == 0' failed` inside `faiss::compute_PQ_dis_tables_dsub2` on the
# AVX2 path: the training parameters the test passes do not satisfy the
# constraint the installed faiss build enforces.
tests/vector_store/test_faiss_index.py::test_builder_trains_pq_index

# --- Count and mock-call drift ------------------------------------------------
# `expected call not found`: the call the Weaviate test records no longer
# matches what the store issues. `assert 2 == 5`: the Jena empty-graph test
# counts operations that all complete only once every concurrent writer has
# landed.
tests/vector_store/test_backend_metadata_filtering.py::TestBackendMetadataFiltering::test_weaviate_store_filter_by_metadata_native_filter
tests/triplet_store/test_jena_store_empty_graph.py::TestJenaStoreEmptyGraph::test_empty_graph_with_concurrent_operations
